### Math foundations

Short lessons that make every later picture readable. Take them as you need them.

::: {.path-list}

- [Vectors and the dot product](lessons/linear-algebra/dot-product.qmd){.published}  
  One number that says how much two lists agree: a weighted score, or how well two arrows line up.
- [Matrix multiply: many dot products at once](lessons/linear-algebra/matrix-multiply.qmd){.published}  
  One operation that scores every drone on every measure at the same time, and the engine inside every neural network.
- [Tensors, shapes and broadcasting](lessons/linear-algebra/tensors.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  Matrices with more than two directions, and how to keep track of their shapes.
- [Derivatives, gradients and the chain rule](lessons/calculus/gradients.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  Which way is downhill, and how fast, when many knobs move at once.
- [Softmax and cross-entropy](lessons/probability/softmax-cross-entropy.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  Turning scores into probabilities, and grading a forecast that was confident and wrong.
:::

### Neural networks

One drone preflight check grows from a single neuron into a trained network.

::: {.path-list}

- [A single neuron](lessons/neural-nets/single-neuron.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  A weighted vote plus a threshold: the smallest possible learned decision.
- [Activation functions](lessons/neural-nets/activations.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  Why networks need a bend, and what ReLU, sigmoid and tanh each do.
- [Layers and the forward pass](lessons/neural-nets/forward-pass.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  Stacking neurons into layers and following a batch of data through them.
- [Loss functions](lessons/neural-nets/loss-functions.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  One number for how wrong the network is, chosen to match the job.
- [Gradient descent and the learning rate](lessons/neural-nets/gradient-descent.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  Walking downhill on the loss, one careful step at a time.
- [Backpropagation](lessons/neural-nets/backpropagation.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  The chain rule, run backward through the network to blame each weight fairly.
- [Overfitting and regularization](lessons/neural-nets/overfitting.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  When a network memorizes instead of learning, and the tools that stop it.
- [Training a real network](lessons/neural-nets/train-a-network.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  Everything so far, in PyTorch, on real telemetry.
:::

### Transformers

One sentence follows you through: "The bank raised the fee because it lost money."

::: {.path-list}

- [Tokens and embeddings](lessons/transformers/tokens-embeddings.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  How text becomes numbers that know which words mean similar things.
- [Sequences, RNNs and why they forget](lessons/transformers/rnns.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  Reading one word at a time, and why long documents defeat it.
- [Attention, the idea](lessons/transformers/attention-idea.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  Every word looks at every other word and decides which ones matter.
- [Queries, keys and values as tensors](lessons/transformers/qkv-tensors.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  The attention idea, written as four matrix steps you can watch.
- [Multi-head attention and position](lessons/transformers/heads-position.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  Several attention patterns at once, and how the model knows word order.
- [The transformer block](lessons/transformers/transformer-block.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  Attention, feed-forward, residuals and normalization, assembled into one layer.
- [Training by next-token prediction](lessons/transformers/next-token-training.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  How a language model learns from nothing but guessing the next word.
- [Build a tiny GPT](lessons/transformers/tiny-gpt.qmd){.planned} [coming soon]{.soon}  
  A working language model you train yourself in a notebook.
:::
